Behavioral signals: per-session quantitative metrics.\n//!\n//! Extracts counts, rates, and patterns from events that a reflection tool\n//! can use to spot behavioral trends across sessions.\n\nuse crate::event::{Event, Role};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\n\n/// Default config/memory file glob patterns used for detection.\n/// Can be overridden via config.toml [behavioral_signals.config_patterns]\nstatic DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"CLAUDE.md\",\n    \"AGENTS.md\",\n    \".claude/\",\n    \".needle/\",\n    \"memory/\",\n    \"docs/notes/\",\n    \"MEMORY.md\",\n];\n\n/// A single config file write event with metadata.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ConfigWriteEvent {\n    /// Path to the config file that was written\n    pub path: String,\n    /// Timestamp when the write occurred\n    pub timestamp: i64,\n    /// Tool type that performed the write (\"Write\" or \"Edit\")\n    pub tool_type: String,\n}\n\n/// Quantitative behavioral metrics for a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\npub struct BehavioralSignals {\n    /// Total tool calls in session\n    pub tool_call_count: u32,\n    /// Tool call counts broken down by tool name\n    pub tool_call_counts_by_name: HashMap<String, u32>,\n    /// Files read more than once in the same session (re-read pattern)\n    pub re_read_files: Vec<String>,\n    /// Number of re-read events (each duplicate read beyond the first counts as one)\n    pub re_read_count: u32,\n    /// Bash commands that returned non-zero exit code\n    pub bash_failure_count: u32,\n    /// Files written/edited more than once (possible revert pattern)\n    pub multi_edit_files: Vec<String>,\n    /// Approximate session duration in seconds (last_ts - first_ts)\n    pub duration_secs: u64,\n    /// Ratio: assistant turns / total turns\n    pub assistant_turn_ratio: f32,\n    /// Whether agent read any config/memory files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/**, .needle/**, memory/, docs/notes/)\n    pub read_config_files: Vec<String>,\n    /// Whether agent wrote/edited any config/memory files\n    pub modified_config_files: Vec<String>,\n    /// Number of times agent switched working directory (cwd changes in events)\n    pub cwd_switch_count: u32,\n    /// Individual config file write events with timestamps and tool types\n    pub config_writes: Vec<ConfigWriteEvent>,\n}\n\n/// Compute behavioral signals from a session's events.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// * `events` - Session events to analyze\n/// * `config_patterns` - Optional config file patterns from config.toml.\n///   If None, uses the default patterns.\npub fn compute_behavioral_signals(events: &[Event], config_patterns: Option<&[String]>) -> BehavioralSignals {\n    let mut signals = BehavioralSignals::default();\n\n    if events.is_empty() {\n        return signals;\n    }\n\n    // Use provided patterns or defaults\n    let patterns = config_patterns.map(|ps| ps.as_ref().into_iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>());\n    let default_patterns: Vec<&str> = DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS.to_vec();\n    let effective_patterns = patterns.as_ref().map(|p| p.as_slice()).unwrap_or(&default_patterns);\n\n    // Track reads, writes, edits per file\n    let mut file_reads: HashMap<&str, u32> = HashMap::new();\n    let mut file_writes_edits: HashMap<&str, u32> = HashMap::new();\n    let mut config_reads: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    let mut config_modifies: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    let mut config_read_seen: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n    let mut config_modify_seen: std::collections::HashSet<String> =\n        std::collections::HashSet::new();\n    let mut config_writes: Vec<ConfigWriteEvent> = Vec::new();\n    let mut total_turns: u32 = 0;\n    let mut assistant_turns: u32 = 0;\n    let mut last_cwd: Option<String> = None;\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Count turns by role (user, assistant, system)\n        match event.role {\n            Role::User | Role::Assistant | Role::System => {\n                total_turns += 1;\n                if event.role == Role::Assistant {\n                    assistant_turns += 1;\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n\n        // Tool calls\n        if event.role == Role::ToolCall {\n            signals.tool_call_count += 1;\n            if let Some(ref tool_name) = event.tool {\n                *signals\n                    .tool_call_counts_by_name\n                    .entry(tool_name.clone())\n                    .or_insert(0) += 1;\n            }\n\n            // Track file reads (Read tool)\n            if event.tool.as_deref() == Some(\"Read\") {\n                if let Some(ref fp) = extract_file_path_from_params(event) {\n                    *file_reads.entry(fp).or_insert(0) += 1;\n\n                    if is_config_file(fp, effective_patterns) && config_read_seen.insert(fp.to_string()) {\n                        config_reads.push(fp.to_string());\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Track file writes (Write tool)\n            if event.tool.as_deref() == Some(\"Write\") {\n                if let Some(ref fp) = extract_file_path_from_params(event) {\n                    *file_writes_edits.entry(fp).or_insert(0) += 1;\n\n                    if is_config_file(fp, effective_patterns) {\n                        if config_modify_seen.insert(fp.to_string()) {\n                            config_modifies.push(fp.to_string());\n                        }\n                        // Track individual config write event\n                        config_writes.push(ConfigWriteEvent {\n                            path: fp.to_string(),\n                            timestamp: event.ts.timestamp(),\n                            tool_type: \"Write\".to_string(),\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Track file edits (Edit tool)\n            if event.tool.as_deref() == Some(\"Edit\") {\n                if let Some(ref fp) = extract_file_path_from_params(event) {\n                    *file_writes_edits.entry(fp).or_insert(0) += 1;\n\n                    if is_config_file(fp, effective_patterns) {\n                        if config_modify_seen.insert(fp.to_string()) {\n                            config_modifies.push(fp.to_string());\n                        }\n                        // Track individual config write event\n                        config_writes.push(ConfigWriteEvent {\n                            path: fp.to_string(),\n                            timestamp: event.ts.timestamp(),\n                            tool_type: \"Edit\".to_string(),\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Track CWD changes (Bash tool with cd commands)\n            if event.tool.as_deref() == Some(\"Bash\") {\n                if let Some(cwd) = detect_cwd_change(event) {\n                    if last_cwd.is_none_or(|prev| prev != cwd.as_str()) {\n                        signals.cwd_switch_count += 1;\n                    }\n                    last_cwd = Some(cwd);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Tool results — check for bash failures\n        if event.role == Role::ToolResult && event.tool.as_deref() == Some(\"Bash\") {\n            if let Some(ref params) = event.tool_params {\n                if let Some(exit_code) = params.get(\"exit_code\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()) {\n                    if exit_code != 0 {\n                        signals.bash_failure_count += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Re-read files: files read more than once\n    for (file, count) in &file_reads {\n        if *count > 1 {\n            signals.re_read_count += count - 1;\n            signals.re_read_files.push(file.to_string());\n        }\n    }\n    signals.re_read_files.sort();\n\n    // Multi-edit files: files written/edited more than once\n    for (file, count) in &file_writes_edits {\n        if *count > 1 {\n            signals.multi_edit_files.push(file.to_string());\n        }\n    }\n    signals.multi_edit_files.sort();\n\n    // Config files\n    signals.read_config_files = config_reads;\n    signals.modified_config_files = config_modifies;\n    signals.config_writes = config_writes;\n\n    // Duration\n    let first_ts = events.first().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap();\n    let last_ts = events.last().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap();\n    signals.duration_secs = (last_ts - first_ts).num_seconds().unsigned_abs();\n\n    // Assistant turn ratio\n    if total_turns > 0 {\n        signals.assistant_turn_ratio = assistant_turns as f32 / total_turns as f32;\n    }\n\n    signals\n}\n\n/// Extract a file_path from a tool_call event's tool_params.\nfn extract_file_path_from_params(event: &Event) -> Option<&str> {\n    event\n        .tool_params\n        .as_ref()\n        .and_then(|p| p.get(\"file_path\"))\n        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n}\n\n/// Check if a file path matches any config/memory file pattern.\nfn is_config_file(path: &str, patterns: &[&str]) -> bool {\n    let path_normalized = path.replace('\\\\', \"/\");\n    for pattern in patterns {\n        // Check as exact suffix match or contains match\n        let segments: Vec<&str> = path_normalized.split('/').collect();\n        for segment in &segments {\n            if *segment == *pattern {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n        // Also check if the path contains the pattern as a directory component\n        if path_normalized.contains(pattern) && pattern.starts_with('.') {\n            return true;\n        }\n        // Check for memory/*.md pattern\n        if (*pattern == \"memory/\" || *pattern == \"docs/notes/\") && path_normalized.contains(pattern)\n        {\n            return true;\n        }\n        // Check for MEMORY.md at root level or in a path\n        if *pattern == \"MEMORY.md\" {\n            let filename = segments.last().copied().unwrap_or(\"\");\n            if filename == \"MEMORY.md\" {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    false\n}\n\n/// Write behavioral signals to a sidecar JSON file.\n///\n/// The sidecar is stored as `sessions/<agent>/<session_id>.behavioral.json`\n/// alongside the session JSONL.\npub fn write_behavioral_sidecar(\n    data_dir: &std::path::Path,\n    session_id: &str,\n    signals: &BehavioralSignals,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let session_dir = data_dir.join(\"sessions\");\n    let parts: Vec<&str> = session_id.splitn(2, '/').collect();\n    if parts.len() != 2 {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let plugin_dir = session_dir.join(parts[0]);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&plugin_dir)?;\n\n    let sidecar_path = plugin_dir.join(format!(\"{}.behavioral.json\", parts[1]));\n    let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(signals)?;\n    std::fs::write(&sidecar_path, json)\n}\n\n/// Load behavioral signals from a session's sidecar file.\n///\n/// Returns None if the sidecar doesn't exist or can't be parsed.\npub fn load_behavioral_signals(\n    data_dir: &std::path::Path,\n    session_id: &str,\n) -> Option<BehavioralSignals> {\n    let session_dir = data_dir.join(\"sessions\");\n    let parts: Vec<&str> = session_id.splitn(2, '/').collect();\n    if parts.len() != 2 {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let sidecar_path = session_dir\n        .join(parts[0])\n        .join(format!(\"{}.behavioral.json\", parts[1]));\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&sidecar_path).ok()?;\n    serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n}\n\n/// Detect a working directory change from a Bash tool_call event.\n///\n/// Looks for `cd <dir>` commands in the Bash tool's params.\nfn detect_cwd_change(event: &Event) -> Option<String> {\n    event\n        .tool_params\n        .as_ref()\n        .and_then(|p| p.get(\"command\"))\n        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n        .and_then(|cmd| {\n            // Simple cd detection: command starts with \"cd \"claude-code/abc123\",\n//!         \"outcome\": \"success\",\n//!         \"summary\": \"Added project conventions to CLAUDE.md\"\n//!       }\n//!     ]\n//!   }\n//! ]\n//! ```\n\nuse crate::error::{AgentScribeError, Result};\nuse crate::event::SessionManifest;\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Duration, Utc};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse tracing::{debug, info};\n\n/// Config/memory file glob patterns used for detection.\n/// Must match patterns in behavioral_signals.rs to ensure ConfigChangeRecord {\n    /// Absolute path to the config file that was modified\n    pub config_file: String,\n    /// Timestamp when the file was last modified\n    pub modified_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n    /// Sessions that ended within 2h before this modification and may have caused it\n    pub correlated_sessions: Vec<CorrelatedSession>,\n}\n\n/// A session correlated with a config change.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CorrelatedSession {\n    /// Session ID\n    pub session_id: String,\n    /// Session outcome\n    pub outcome: String,\n    /// Session summary (first sentence)\n    pub summary: String,\n    /// When the session ended\n    pub ended_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n}\n\n/// Tracker for correlating config file changes with sessions.\npub struct ConfigChangeTracker {\n    /// Data directory\n    data_dir: PathBuf,\n    /// Known projects to scan (from session manifests)\n    projects: HashMap<String, ProjectInfo>,\n}\n\n/// Metadata about a tracked project.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct ProjectInfo {\n    /// Project path\n    path: PathBuf,\n    /// Last scan timestamp\n    last_scanned: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n}\n\nimpl ConfigChangeTracker {\n    /// Create a new tracker.\n    pub fn new(data_dir: PathBuf) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            data_dir,\n            projects: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Track config changes after scraping.\n    ///\n    /// This should be called after each scrape to detect newly modified\n    /// config files and correlate them with recent sessions.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `session_manifests` - All session manifests from the scrape (used to discover projects and correlate)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// Number of config change correlations found\n    pub fn track_after_scrape(&mut self, session_manifests: &[SessionManifest]) -> Result<usize> {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let scan_threshold = now - Duration::hours(CONFIG_SCAN_WINDOW_HOURS);\n\n        // Discover projects from session manifests\n        self.update_projects_from_manifests(session_manifests);\n\n        // Scan for modified config files\n        let modified_configs = self.scan_modified_configs(&scan_threshold)?;\n\n        if modified_configs.is_empty() {\n            debug!(\"No recently modified config files found\");\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        // Correlate with sessions\n        let mut correlations = Vec::new();\n        for (config_path, modified_at) in modified_configs {\n            let correlated =\n                self.find_correlated_sessions(&config_path, modified_at, session_manifests)?;\n\n            if !correlated.is_empty() {\n                correlations.push(ConfigChangeRecord {\n                    config_file: config_path,\n                    modified_at,\n                    correlated_sessions: correlated,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        if !correlations.is_empty() {\n            self.store_correlations(&correlations)?;\n            info!(\n                count = correlations.len(),\n                \"Tracked config change correlations\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(correlations.len())\n    }\n\n    /// Update tracked projects from session manifests.\n    fn project.clone();\n                let info = self\n                    .projects\n                    .entry(path.clone())\n                    .or_insert_with(|| ProjectInfo {\n                        path: PathBuf::from(&path),\n                        last_scanned: None,\n                    });\n                // Mark as scanned now\n                info.last_scanned = Some(Utc::now());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Scan for config files modified within the time window.\n    ///\n    /// Returns list of (config_file_path, modified_at) tuples.\n    fn scan_modified_configs(\n        &self,\n        threshold: &DateTime<Utc>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<(String, DateTime<Utc>)>> {\n        let mut modified = Vec::new();\n\n        for project_path in self.projects.keys() {\n            // Scan each pattern within the project\n            for pattern in CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS {\n                let config_candidates = self.find_config_files(project_path, pattern);\n\n                for config_path in config_candidates {\n                    if let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(&config_path) {\n                        if let Ok(modified_ts) = metadata.modified() {\n                            let modified_at: DateTime<Utc> = modified_ts.into();\n                            if modified_at > *threshold {\n                                modified\n                                    .push((config_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(), modified_at));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        modified.sort_by_key(|(_, ts)| *ts);\n        modified.reverse(); // Most recent first\n\n        Ok(modified)\n    }\n\n    /// Find config files matching a pattern within a project.\n    fn find_config_files(&self, project_path: &str, pattern: &str) -> Vec<PathBuf> {\n        let project = Path::new(project_path);\n        let mut matches = Vec::new();\n\n        // Handle different pattern types\n        if pattern.ends_with('/') {\n            // Directory pattern: scan for files inside\n            let dir = if pattern.starts_with('.') {\n                // Hidden directory like .claude/, .needle/\n                project.join(pattern)\n            } else {\n                // Regular directory like memory/, docs/notes/\n                project.join(pattern)\n            };\n\n            if dir.is_dir() {\n                if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&dir) {\n                    for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                        matches.push(entry.path());\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } else if pattern.contains('.') {\n            // File pattern like CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md\n            let file = project.join(pattern);\n            if file.exists() {\n                matches.push(file);\n            }\n        }\n\n        matches\n    }\n\n    /// Find sessions that ended within 2h before a config modification.\n    fn find_correlated_sessions(\n        &self,\n        config_path: &str,\n        modified_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n        manifests: &[SessionManifest],\n    ) -> Result<Vec<CorrelatedSession>> {\n        let correlation_threshold = modified_at - Duration::hours(SESSION_CORRELATION_WINDOW_HOURS);\n        let mut correlated = Vec::new();\n\n        for      let touched_config = self.session_touched_config(manifest, config_path);\n\n                    if touched_config || self.session_in_same_project(manifest, config_path) {\n                        correlated.push(CorrelatedSession {\n                            session_id: manifest.session_id.clone(),\n                            outcome: manifest.outcome.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unknown\").to_string(),\n                            summary: manifest.summary.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                            ended_at: ended,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Sort by recency (most recent first)\n        correlated.sort_by(|a, b| config_path: &str) -> bool {\n        manifest\n            .files_touched\n            .iter()\n            .any(|f| f.as_str() == config_path || f.as_str() == config_path.replace('\\\\', \"/\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Check if a session worked in the same project as a config file.\n    fn session_in_same_project(&self, manifest: &SessionManifest, config_path: &str) -> bool {\n        if let Some(ref project) = manifest.project {\n            // Config file is in the session's project directory\n            config_path.starts_with(project) || config_path.starts_with(&project.replace('\\\\', \"/\"))\n        } else {\n            false\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Store config change correlations to disk.\n    fn store_correlations(&self, correlations: &[ConfigChangeRecord]) -> Result<()> {\n        let changes_dir = self.data_dir.join(\"config-changes\");\n        fs::create_dir_all(&changes_dir)?;\n\n        let date = Utc::now().format(\"%Y-%m-%d\").to_string();\n        let file_path = changes_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", date));\n\n        // Load existing correlations for today\n        let mut existing: Vec<ConfigChangeRecord> = if file_path.exists() {\n            let content = fs::read_to_string(&file_path)?;\n            serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default()\n        } else {\n            Vec::new()\n        };\n\n        // Merge new correlations (avoid duplicates by config_file + modified_at)\n        for new_corr in correlations {\n            let is_duplicate = existing.iter().any(|existing| {\n                existing.config_file == new_corr.config_file\n                    && existing.modified_at == new_corr.modified_at\n            });\n\n            if !is_duplicate {\n                existing.push(new_corr.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Sort by modification time (most recent first)\n        existing.sort_by(|a, b| b.modified_at.cmp(&a.modified_at));\n\n        // Write back\n        let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&existing).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::Config(format!(\"Failed to serialize config changes: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n        fs::write(&file_path, json)?;\n\n        debug!(\n            path = %file_path.display(),\n            count = existing.len(),\n            \"Stored config change correlations\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::event::Event;\n    use chrono::TimeZone;\n\n    fn make_manifest(\n        session_id: &str,\n        project: /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `session_manifests` - All session manifests from the scrape (used to discover projects and correlate)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// Number of config change correlations found\n    pub fn track_after_scrape(&mut self, session_manifests: &[SessionManifest]) -> Result<usize> {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let scan_threshold = now - \"Tracked config change correlations\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(correlations.len())\n    }\n\n    /// Update tracked projects from session manifests.\n    fn  path: PathBuf::from(&path),\n                        last_scanned: None,\n                    });\n                // Mark as scanned now\n                info.last_scanned = Some(Utc::now());\n for config_path in config_candidates {\n                    if let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(&config_path) {\n                        if let Ok(modified_ts) = metadata.modified() {\n                            let modified_at: DateTime<Utc> = modified_ts.into();\n                            if modified_at > *threshold {\n                                modified\n                                    .push((config_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(), modified_at));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n find_config_files(&self, project_path: &str, pattern: &str) -> Vec<PathBuf> {\n        let project = Path::new(project_path);\n        let mut matches = Vec::new();\n\n        // Handle different pattern types\n        if pattern.ends_with('/') {\n            // Directory pattern: scan for files inside\n            let dir = if pattern.starts_with('.') {\n                // Hidden directory };\n\n            if dir.is_dir() {\n                if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&dir) {\n                    for entry in entries.flatten() {\n       }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Scan for config files modified within the time window.\n    ///\n    /// Returns list of (config_file_path, modified_at) tuples.\n    fn scan_modified_configs(\n pattern types\n        if pattern.ends_with('/') {\n            // Directory pattern: scan for files inside\n            let dir = if pattern.starts_with('.') {\n                // Hidden directory };\n\n            if dir.is_dir() {\n                if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&dir) {\n                    for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                        matches.push(entry.path());\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } else if pattern.contains('.') {\n            // File pattern like CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md\n
